# Next.js 16+ App Router Architectural Goals

- Target Runtime: Next.js 16+ (App Router, Turbopack, React 19.2+)
- Typescript: Strict 5.5+, No Enums, Satisfies Operator
- CSS: Tailwind v4 (OKLCH Light Mode, Swiss Design Doctrine)
- Zero New Routes Invariant
- Read-Only Invariant for Application Code during Audit
